fields.fees_bylaw_name: In Topsoil Removal By-law 24-2016 (prohibitory only; verified $0 in 2026 Fees By-law 2026-03)
fields.fee_formula_notes: Visual inspection of all 3 pages of Topsoil Removal By-law 24-2016 (passed Dec 14, 2016) confirms it is strictly a prohibitory topsoil-removal by-law with no permit system, no fees, and does not regulate placing or importing fill (s. 3.7–3.8 exempts Drainage Act & incidental NFP topsoil removal excl. sale). Visual inspection of all 14 pages of 2026 Comprehensive Fees & Charges By-law 2026-03 (passed Jan 21, 2026, Schedules A–F) confirms $0 / no topsoil, fill, or site alteration permit fees.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees & Charges By-law (confirmed in 2027 Schedule, pp. 28–29) & Site Alteration By-law 87-24
fields.security_deposit_terms: Refundable security (LOC, certified cheque, or cash) up to 100% of estimated site control/stabilization/haul-route restoration works as determined by Director (By-law 87-24 s. 11.5–11.7)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Fill quality/quantity testing billed at actual costs + 15% admin fee; applicant retains Qualified Person for site drawings & MECP excess soil BMP compliance
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 87-24 s. 2.1(n)(iv) exempts <1,000 m³ topsoil alteration/addition on Agricultural Lands used for an Agricultural Operation (≥1m from lot line, no adverse drainage); s. 2.1(l) also exempts ≤1,000 m³/yr (≤0.2m grade) for sod/greenhouse/nursery restoration. Above 1,000 m³, dedicated Agricultural Site Alteration Application Fee is $1,121.52 (2026 & 2027, HST exempt; vs. $2,859.27 General) + $2.15/m³ imported/exported fill fee 'at the discretion of the Director' (renewal $287.65; revision 50%). Benchmarks include the $2.15/m³ rate; if waived by Director, fee is $1,121.52 flat.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Schedule 1 – 2024-2027 Fees and Charges (May 26, 2026 Final, Community Development — Planning: Site Alteration SA.1-SA.39, pp. 63-64)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 29-2023 s. 12 & Sched 1 (SA.2-SA.35): Cash, certified cheque, surety bond, or LOC (60-day expiry notice) in amount determined by Director (residential infill $3,000; other residential $1,500; C/I/I & outside-subdivision site alterations determined by Director)
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 29-2023 s. 5.1.4, 5.1.6 & Sched A: Applicant must retain P.Eng./Qualified Person for Plans, ESC oversight, and MECP Excess Soil BMP reconciliation report at applicant's cost; Director may require soil testing of source locations
fields.fee_formula_notes: Site Alteration By-law 29-2023 s. 4.1.12 exempts FBRN-registered Agricultural Lands for site alteration/addition/removal of <1,000 m³ of Topsoil for an Agricultural Operation (>=1.0 m from property line, no adverse drainage; s. 4.1.11 also exempts <=1,000 m³/yr topsoil restoration <=0.2 m depth for sod/greenhouse/nurseries; s. 4.1.13 exempts Nutrient Management Act fill). Above 1,000 m³, Schedule 1 (2024-2027 Fees & Charges, May 26, 2026 Final, pp. 63-64, HST exempt): SA.34 ('site alterations outside of the subdivision process and new subdivisions', formerly 'Other Site Alteration not included above') = $2,500.00 + $500.00/ha (2026-2027; up from $1,100 + $50/ha in 2024-2025; renewal SA.36 $600); SA.29 C/I/I Other Site Alterations = $2,000.00 flat (renewal $450; live webpage still displays pre-May-2026 $2,000 flat for other site alterations); Residential SA.1/SA.20 = $600 ($350 minor SA.17); Amendment SA.38 up to 50% of fee. No out-of-municipality fill ban in By-law 29-2023.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Fees & Charges By-law 2025-61 (amended 2026-09, p. 9) & Site Alteration By-law 65-2009
fields.security_deposit_terms: >400 to <2,000 m³: $2,000 deposit; >2,000 m³: $5,000/ha of area + $5,000 damage deposit (includes mud tracking & dust control)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Any other costs incurred in excess of listed fees charged on a full cost recovery basis; chemical fill analysis & grading plans required (By-law 65-2009 s. 6)
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2025-61 (amended 2026-09, p. 9, visually verified): ≤400 m³/yr (~20 tri-axle loads, By-law 65-2009 s. 7(g)) exempt ($0; extension $150); >400 to <2,000 m³ = $500 flat permit fee (may be waived under delegated authority); >2,000 m³ = $2,000 flat permit fee (NO $/m³ charge). Separate Site Alteration Agreement preparation fee: $1,000 Medium Scale (250–2,000 m³) or $2,500 Large Scale (>2,000 m³) if required; amendment $500/$1,000.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: In Site Alteration By-law No. 14-2015 (s. 6.2(c) & Sched. B; confirmed active on 2026 Township portal)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 14-2015 s. 6.2(c)-(e): Mandatory $20,000.00 refundable deposit with application to cover engineering/professional review costs, replenished to full $20,000.00 prior to commencing approved site alteration (unused balance refunded without interest on completion); Township may also fix liquidated damages for haul routes (s. 7.2).
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 14-2015 s. 6.2(c) & Sched. A: Township engineering and professional review costs recovered from $20,000.00 deposit; applicants must submit Soil Management Plan (MOE BMP), Hydrogeology Report, Surface Water Drainage Report, EIS, Agricultural Rehabilitation Plan, and Traffic Impact Study.
fields.fee_formula_notes: Site Alteration By-law 14-2015 (passed Apr 14, 2015, visually verified from scanned PDF and confirmed active on 2026 Township webpage https://www.eastgarafraxa.ca/business-and-development/site-alteration/): s. 3.1(b) exempts topsoil removal incidental to NFP only; s. 3.1(g) exempts placing/dumping/removing ≤15 tri-axle truck loads (≈300 m³) in any 1-year period with no drainage impact ($0). Above 300 m³/yr requires public Council Approval (s. 6.1–6.6, evaluating agricultural capability/NFP): $2,000.00 non-refundable flat processing fee + $20,000.00 refundable review deposit (no $/m³ volumetric fee). Approval valid 1 year; 6-month renewal = $1,000.00 (Sched. B s. 1(c)).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law (Schedule F — Public Works Applications; matching By-law 29-2004 Sched. D)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 29-2004 s. 12: Written agreement may require a security deposit equal to 100% of the approved cost estimate for the work authorized by the permit.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 29-2004 s. 12 & Sched. D: Owner pays Corporation's actual costs of reviewing and approving plans and work plus actual costs for preparation and registration of any required agreement.
fields.fee_formula_notes: 2026 Fees & Charges By-law Schedule F (p. 12, HST exempt, unchanged from By-law 29-2004 Sched. D): Site Alteration Permit = $100.00 for Residential 90-day permit; $500.00 for all other properties (including farms) 90-day permit; +$100.00 extra for 180-day permit ($600.00 total). Renewal = 50% of original fee (By-law 29-2004 s. 10). No $/m³ volumetric fee. By-law 29-2004 s. 3–4 exempt tillage, Drainage Act/Tile Drainage Act, incidental NAP topsoil removal, and land holdings <2,800 m² outside 120 m of hazard/EP zones (no NFP fill import exemption).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: In Site Alteration By-law 2014-31 (s. 6.2 & Schedule A, amended by 2020-27)
fields.security_deposit_terms: $20,000.00 refundable deposit for Town engineering/professional reviews (s. 6.2) + $20,000.00 refundable performance/road security deposit (Schedule A s. 1(h))
fields.peer_review_recovery: Town engineering & professional review costs drawn from $20,000 refundable review deposit; P.Eng./OLS final grading certification required prior to deposit release
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2014-31 s. 3.1(g) exempts <250 m³/yr of locally sourced fill per lot. Any fill ≥250 m³ (or non-local fill) requires a Council Variance/Exception under s. 6.2 with a $2,000.00 non-refundable flat processing fee (no $/m³ fee), public hearing (500m neighbour notice), and $20,000 engineering review deposit + $20,000 security deposit. Council considers agricultural capability & NFP criteria (s. 6.6).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Consolidated Fees and Charges By-law 109-2024 (amended through By-law 3-2026, Schedule D, pp. 70-71)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 85-2006 s. 5.2(h): Security in a form and amount determined by the Director to secure performance of the work
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 85-2006 s. 6.3: Testing of any Fill by a City-retained qualified expert at Applicant's expense; Fees By-law 109-2024 Sched D (p. 69): Peer Review of development application = 100% of City costs + 10% admin fee
fields.fee_formula_notes: Consolidated Fees & Charges By-law 109-2024 (amended through By-law 3-2026, Schedule D, eff. Jan 1, 2026, pp. 70-71): Agricultural Fill Operations — importation of 500 m³ or less and up to 4 inches in depth of topsoil for Agricultural purposes = No Charge ($0). Standard Fill Operations (import/export of topsoil): <20 m³ = No Charge; 20-100 m³ = $257.50; >100 m³ = $500.00 + $1.00/m³ (replaced 2025 >500 m³ flat $4,000 tier, now marked N/A). Renewal = 50% of initial fee (By-law 85-2006 s. 7.2); Violation & Investigation = 100% of applicable fee. No out-of-municipality fill ban in By-law 85-2006.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: General Municipal Fees By-law 6191/03 (Schedule I — 2026 User Fees, approved Nov 24, 2025; amended by By-law 8264/26, p. 36)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 6060/02 Sched A & 2026 User Fees (p. 36): Irrevocable LOC/security for 100% of estimated cost of Erosion & Sediment Control and site control measures + Road Damage Security ($7,700/km Paved Road; $12,845/km Surface Treated/Gravel Road, eff. Jan 6, 2026)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Qualified professional ESC Plan & Design Report required (By-law 6060/02 s. 7-8); external Peer Reviews charged to applicant under 2026 User Fees
fields.fee_formula_notes: 2026 User Fees (Development Services, p. 36, eff. Jan 6, 2026, HST exempt): Fill/Topsoil Permit (1-year) = $1,215.00 + $1,215.00/ha to a max total fee of $6,075.00 (up from $1,185 + $1,185/ha max $5,925 in 2025). One-year extension = $1,215.00; Penalty & Investigation Fee = $6,090.00. By-law 6060/02 s. 2(h) exempts incidental normal farm practice topsoil removal only (no fill-import exemption); City webpage notes >20 m³ (2 dump trucks) triggers a permit. No out-of-municipality fill ban in By-law 6060/02.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Site Alteration By-law 2010-084 (Schedule A — 2021 Fees, p. 19; Cloudpermit administered)
fields.security_deposit_terms: Non-exempt permits: $3,000 or 100% of land restoration cost (whichever is greater) + highway maintenance security TBD by CBO (Schedule A)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Non-exempt permits: all external legal, engineering, hydrology, environmental, arborist & consultant evaluation costs charged back + 5% admin fee (s. 4.9, 6.1(g))
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2010-084 s. 3.1(m) & s. 3.2(f) exempt topsoil removal and replacement of topsoil for restoration of agricultural lands used for normal agricultural practices (storage ≤1,000 m³; tracked as Farm Exempt = Yes). For non-exempt/commercial fill permits, Schedule A (2021) charges $560 + $5.00/m³ (<1,000 m³) and $800 + $5.00/m³ (>1,000 m³) + external costs + 5% admin (extension $275/$440; double fees + $250/inspection if unpermitted). Note: Uxbridge processes permits via Cloudpermit; confirm latest Fees By-law indexing for commercial rates.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Consolidated Fees & Charges By-law 7220-17 (amended through 8201-25 & 8251-25, Schedule T Engineering Services, pp. 75-78)
fields.security_deposit_terms: Schedule T & Site Alteration Guideline App B (cash or LOC): Cat 2 (<500 m³) = $1,500 on-site controls + $3,127 immediate road damage (ENG-15) + $1,000 overfill; Cat 3 (>=500 m³) = Engineer's estimate + 30% + HST on-site controls + $5,212 immediate road damage (ENG-16) + 15% of Road Damage/Inspection Fee overfill security + $2,000 signage + $10,000 soil testing/peer review (+ $10,000 per additional 50,000 m³)
fields.peer_review_recovery: 100% of Municipality's Peer Review costs (Guideline App C & Sched T) + 15% Engineering Peer Review Admin Fee (+ HST, ENG-5); $10,000 upfront soil testing/peer review security (Cat 3); Registered Agrology Practitioner Report required for agricultural topsoil
fields.fee_formula_notes: Consolidated Fees By-law 7220-17 Schedule T (eff. Jan 1, 2026, HST exempt) + By-law 7425-18 (amended by 8292-26) & Guideline v1.5/v1.6: Cat 2 Small (<500 m³, ENG-44) = $2,929.00 flat (no initial Road Damage/Inspection Fee per Guideline s. 5.2.15); Cat 3 Large (>=500 m³, ENG-45) = $5,857.00 + $2.30/m³ Road Damage Contribution/Inspection Fee (ENG-11). Extension (ENG-9) = 50% of initial app fee; Condition Amendment (ENG-8) = $309.61; Overfill Fee (ENG-10) = $2.30/m³ (1x/2x/4x sliding penalty per App E); Road Replacement (ENG-12..14) = $19.91-$352.14/m² if required. By-law 7425-18 s. 3.5 exempts topsoil removal/restoration incidental only to sod-farming/greenhouses/nurseries (Agrology Report required); s. 3.6 requires permit for other agricultural grade alterations. No out-of-municipality fill ban.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Environmental & Infrastructure Fees By-law 94-2025 (Schedule A, p. 7, eff. Jan 1, 2026)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 140-2025 Sched B Table 1: Irrevocable LOC, certified cheque or bank draft — Cat 1 Res R1–R4 $1,000 + HST; Cat 2 Dev <1 ac = 5% grading/ESC + 50% site stabilization; Cat 3 Dev >1 ac (excl. subdiv) = 10% grading/ESC + 50% stabilization; Cat 4 Subdivisions = 15% grading/ESC + 100% stabilization.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 140-2025 s. 3.1(i) & s. 7.3: Director may retain/appoint peer review consultant; By-law 94-2025 Sched A p. 7 execution of orders = Costs + 15%.
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 94-2025 (passed Sept 8, 2025, eff. Jan 1, 2026, visually verified scanned PDF Schedule A p. 7): Site Alteration Application Fee = $110.00 flat (R1–R4 residential lots exempt); Additional Inspection = $130.00; Extension = $55.00 (50%); Minor Amendment = $55.00 (50%); Transfer/Renewal = $27.50; Administration Fee = $50.00 (+ HST where applicable). Site Alteration By-law 140-2025 (passed Dec 1, 2025) s. 5.1(a) exempts only statutory Drainage Act & incidental NFP topsoil removal (excl. sale); s. 7.5 allows discretionary Director waiver.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Fill and Grade By-law 1799 (Schedule A, as amended by By-law 2336, June 3, 2024)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2336 (amending 1799 Sched A): Refundable security deposit of $500.00 + $0.50/m³ of fill (Officer may increase for rehabilitation/drainage/erosion); Road Damage Undertaking & $2M CGL insurance
fields.peer_review_recovery: P.Eng. design & post-completion certification of grade changes required (By-law 1799 s. 4.3, Sched A s. 5(h))
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2336 (passed June 3, 2024) amended Fill & Grade By-law 1799 to cap lifetime fill importation at 1,200 m³ per property (s. 4.3), set the Fill Permit application fee at $500.00 flat (up from $200/$300/$400 in original 1799 Sched A), and set the refundable security deposit at $500.00 + $0.50/m³. Benchmarks above 1,200 m³ (5,000 & 15,000 m³) are intentionally left blank because >1,200 m³ lifetime fill is prohibited.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 User Fees By-law 2026-009 (p. 22, Fill Permit) & Fill By-law 7080
fields.security_deposit_terms: Not specified in By-law 7080 or 2026-009; unpaid remediation work added to tax roll
fields.peer_review_recovery: Fill-control/grading plan required when requested by CBO or Town Engineer (By-law 7080 s. 5(2)(c))
fields.fee_formula_notes: 2026 User Fees By-law 2026-009 (p. 22): Fill Permit = $55.00 flat (increased from $50.00 in 2025; no $/m³ fee). Permit renewal within expiry window = 50% of original fee (By-law 7080 s. 7). Farm exemption covers statutory topsoil removal only (s. 4(l)).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: In Dumping, Filling, Grading & Topsoil Removal By-law 2004-29 (Schedule A, p. 8; active in 2026)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2004-29 s. 4.4: Officer may require security/bond/agreement conditions as part of permit issuance.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 2004-29 s. 3.1: Applicant provides grading/drainage plan & engineering details at own expense; 2026 Building Fees By-law 2025-128 Sched 3 lists Lot Grading Review Fee $380 non-residential ($270 residential).
fields.fee_formula_notes: Dumping, Filling, Grading & Topsoil Removal By-law 2004-29 (passed May 18, 2004, visually verified 8p scanned PDF) s. 4.1 & Schedule A (p. 8): Permit Fee = $100.00 flat (waived under s. 4.2 when accompanying a building permit). Verified 2026 Admin Fees By-law 2025-119 (19p) and 2026 Building Fees By-law 2025-128 Sched 3 do not supersede By-law 2004-29's $100 fill permit fee (Building Sched 3 only sets Lot Grading Review Fees: $270 res / $380 all other). s. 5.1–5.2 requires a permit on Agricultural zones for OMAFRA-approved farm practice or altering irregular features; s. 4.5(g) restricts exporting removed topsoil outside Town limits (not importing fill).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Approved User Fee Schedule (Building Services — Permit/Policy & Regulatory Services, Items 21–23)
fields.peer_review_recovery: 2026 Approved User Fee Schedule lists related Lot Grading Review (non-house) at $555.00/review.
fields.fee_formula_notes: 2026 Approved User Fee Schedule (Building Services, Items 21–23, HST exempt) under By-law 6938 — area-based in m² (not $/m³): <500 m² = $75.00 minimum fee (2025: $70.00); 500–1,000 m² = $75.00 + $0.05/m²; >1,000 m² = $75.00 + $0.03/m². Renewal within 6 months = 50% of original fee (By-law 6938 s. 5). Urban bylaw with no agricultural/NFP exemption (exempts ≤25 mm lawn/garden dressing >1 m from lot line, building permits, subdivisions, CA regulated areas).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law 2026-7 (and Site Alteration By-law 2008-128 s. 4(d) NFP Exemption)
fields.security_deposit_terms: When permit required (non-exempt works >$50,000, By-law 2008-128 s. 8(2)): cash, certified cheque, or irrevocable bank LOC = 10% of first $200,000 estimated works cost + 1% of cost exceeding $200,000.
fields.peer_review_recovery: When permit required (By-law 2008-128 s. 8(3)): Applicant must submit Control Plan, EIS (if natural heritage), Stage 1+ Archaeological Assessment, and P.Eng./qualified person completion certification at owner's expense.
fields.fee_formula_notes: Site Alteration By-law 2008-128 (cons. 2009-11) s. 4(d) verbatim exempts all Site Alteration (placing/dumping fill, grade alteration) undertaken 'as part of a Normal Farm Practice, including, but not limited to, sod-farming, greenhouse operations, nurseries, and Agricultural Operations, but not including the removal of topsoil for sale, exchange, or other disposition' ($0; s. 4(k) also exempts rural landscaping fill outside EP/OS with ≤3:1 slope; s. 5(5) Drainage Act). For non-exempt sites, 2026 Fees & Charges By-law 2026-7 (passed Dec 16, 2025, updated Oct 1, 2026) sets: Site Alteration Permit = $491.68 + HST; Renewal (≥30 days pre-expiry) = $245.04 + HST.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law 2026-22 (Schedule G — Planning & Development, p. 10)
fields.security_deposit_terms: When non-exempt (By-law 2026-22 Sched G p. 10): Fill >500–<2,000 m³ = $2,000 security deposit; Fill >2,000 m³ = $5,000/ha security deposit + $5,000 mud-tracking/dust damage deposit.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 2026-22 Sched G p. 10: Site Alteration Agreement prep = $1,000 (Medium 250–2,000 m³) or $2,500 (Large >2,000 m³; amendment $1,000); 'Any other costs incurred in excess of the fees listed above will be charged at a full cost recovery basis.'
fields.fee_formula_notes: Site Alteration By-law 2018-49 (visually verified scanned PDF) s. 1.41.3 excludes 'The carrying out of Agricultural Uses' from 'Site Alteration', AND s. 7.3.9 explicitly exempts 'Placement or Removal of Topsoil as an incidental part of normal agricultural practices' (excl. topsoil removal for sale) -> $0 for clean farm topsoil import. Also s. 7.1–7.2 exempts <0.5 ha not adjacent to EP. For non-exempt fill (By-law 2026-22 Sched G p. 10, eff. Feb 19, 2026): <500 m³ = $70.00 (may be waived); >500 to <2,000 m³ = $500.00 (+ $1,000 agmt); >2,000 m³ = $2,000.00 (+ $2,500 agmt); extension ≤500 m³ = $150.00.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Fees & Charges By-law 2025-009 (Consolidated 2026, Schedule E p. 11) & Site Alteration By-law 2023-083
fields.security_deposit_terms: Haul Route Agreement required for permits >1,000 m³ on municipal highways; securities for road improvements/damage repair TBD by Director (By-law 2023-083 s. 5.1, 5.5)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Qualified Person pre- & post-construction topographic surveys and monthly scale load tickets required to reconcile actual volume (s. 11.3, 12.6); O. Reg. 406/19 compliance
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2023-083 s. 2.4 & s. 2.6 exempt ≤1,000 m³ in any consecutive 12-month period ($0; no permit or registration required). Above 1,000 m³ (By-law 2025-009 Sched E p. 11, excl. HST): Permit Fee = $300.00 + Haul Route Fee = $1.10/m³ when utilizing Municipal Highways (50% of volume fee due upfront on est. +10%, reconciled to actual; 50% fee reduction under s. 11.5 if owner completes structural road improvements; extension $150). Projects >1,000 m³ not using municipal highways require $150 Registration only.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees & Charges By-law 2026-09 (Schedule E p. 20 & Sched C p. 15–16) & Grading By-law 058-2010
fields.security_deposit_terms: $1,500.00 refundable grading/security deposit per By-law 058-2010 s. 4(c) (Schedule E also lists Grading Permit First Lot $1,500 / Second Lot $750 / Subsequent $500; Rural Road Damage Deposit $1,000)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Drainage & grading plan prepared and certified upon completion by P.Eng. or OLS (By-law 058-2010 s. 4(b),(d)); additional engineering review fees where required (Sched C p. 15)
fields.fee_formula_notes: 2026 Fees & Charges By-law 2026-09 Schedule E (p. 20): Grading Permit Application – Fill & Alteration Inspection Fee (Non-refundable) = $225.00 flat (up from $120.00 in By-law 058-2010 s. 4(a); waived if issued with a Building Permit). Note: Schedule E also lists Grading Permit – First Lot $1,500.00 (corresponding to By-law 058-2010 $1,500 grading deposit referenced in Sched C Note 5), and Sched C Building lists Lot Grading $1,545.00 + review fees. No $/m³ fee.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: In Fill By-law 2002-78 (Office Consolidation, s. 4)
fields.security_deposit_terms: $3,000.00 refundable security deposit required as a condition of any fill permit (By-law 2002-78 s. 4(c))
fields.peer_review_recovery: Drainage & grading plan prepared and post-completion certified by P.Eng. or OLS prior to release of $3,000 deposit (s. 4(b),(d))
fields.fee_formula_notes: Fill By-law 2002-78 (Office Consolidation) s. 4(a): Flat $100.00 permit fee (no $/m³ rate; waived if issued in conjunction with a Building Permit) + $3,000.00 security deposit. Administered via Cloudpermit; cross-check Building/Engineering schedules for any future CPI updates.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Fees and Charges By-law No. 2026-15 (No Site Alteration / Relief Fee Published; By-law 2023-101 Shoreline/EP Only)
fields.security_deposit_terms: No site alteration security deposit published in By-law 2023-101 or 2026 Fees By-law 2026-15.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 2023-101 s. 8.1 requires a landscape and/or grading and drainage plan at applicant expense for relief requests; no standalone site alteration peer-review tariff is itemized in By-law 2026-15 (Planning Sched. E lists $5,000 peer review deposit for Planning Act applications).
fields.fee_formula_notes: Site Alteration By-law 2023-101 (passed Nov 28, 2023) s. 3.1 applies ONLY within 30 m of a high water mark and within Environmental Protection (EP) zones (agricultural lands outside 30 m shoreline buffers/EP zones are unregulated). Within shoreline/EP zones there is no standard fill permit tier or agricultural exemption — only s. 8.1 Relief requests to the CBO ('with the applicable fee') and POA set fines ($500–$700). Checked 2026 Fees & Charges By-law 2026-15 (Schedules A–F) and 2026 Building By-law 2025-106: no Site Alteration or s. 8.1 Relief fee dollar amount is published online.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Municipal Rates and Service Charges By-law No. 2025-0104 (Transportation & Public Works — Engineering Site Alteration, p. 16)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2025-0009 s. 11.1: 100% of estimated cost of site control measures, stabilization, completion, municipal highway/public works restoration, and Town inspection/consulting costs (certified cheque <$5,000; irrevocable LOC or certified cheque >=$5,000)
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 2025-0009 s. 11.1(a)(vii) & Schedules C/E/H: Applicant guarantees payment of all Town peer review, QA/QC, inspection, sampling, and consulting costs; By-law 2025-0104 Engineering staff time $104/hr regular ($155/hr after-hours) + 15% admin
fields.fee_formula_notes: Site Alteration By-law 2025-0009 (eff. Apr 1, 2025) Sched B s. 3.1(a) exempts Rural Agricultural Use zoned lots up to 29 m³ topsoil per consecutive 6-month period (<=0.15 m grade increase, >=0.6 m from lot line). Oct 15, 2021) s. 2.2(j) exempts placing <500 m³/yr of Fill on agriculturally zoned land >2 ha if placed ≥10 m from property lines ($0; strictly '<500 m³', so 500 m³ hits Tier A = $1,960). s. 3.6–3.7 also waives lot-grading plan for <1,000 m³ agricultural land improvement. Above exemption, 2026 User Fees By-law 3609-25 Sched F (pp. 31–32, eff. Jan 1, 2026, HST N/A; confirmed on 2026 Permit App v1.0-2026): Tier A (≤1,000 m³) = $1,800.00 + $0.32/m³; Tier B (1,001–20,000 m³) = $5,000.00 + $0.32/m³; Tier C (≥20,001 m³) = $5,000.00 + $0.32/m³.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Fees and Charges By-law 2026-047 (eff. Sept 1, 2026)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2010-066 s. 5(d) & s. 7(e): Cash deposit or Canadian chartered bank LOC in amount determined by General Manager; Schedule D s. 6 tree protection financial security held 24 months post-final inspection (ISA appraisal).
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 2010-066 s. 7(g)–(h) & Sched B/D: Applicant must supply certified lab fill quality tests (O. Reg. 153/04), Phase 1/2 ESA/RSC if required, P.Eng./P.Geo./CET-stamped Site Alteration Plan, and arborist report (if within TPZ) at owner's expense.
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2026-047 (eff. Sept 1, 2026; confirmed on waterloo.ca/apply-to-alter-a-site) — area-based, not $/m³: Site Alteration Application Fee = $160.00 (2025: $154) + Permit Fee = $555.00 for first hectare or less (2025: $538) + $92.00 per additional hectare (2025: $89) to a maximum permit fee of $2,000.00 (total combined $715.00 min to $2,160.00 max). By-law 2010-066 s. 4(a) & Sched A exempts statutory s. 142 Municipal Act uses (Drainage Act, incidental NFP topsoil removal excl. sale) and <20 m³/yr (if not adjacent to waterbody).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law 58-2025 (Schedule C — Development Services, pp. 22–24)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 58-2025 Sched C p. 23: Refundable security for default/breach = $5,000 or greater as determined by Director; Haul route highway restoration/maintenance security TBD by Director.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 58-2025 Sched C p. 23: Peer Review = Actual costs + 15% admin fee; Fill Quality Testing = Actual costs + 15% admin fee; Additional Meetings $300/hr; Additional Field Inspections $160/unit.
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 51-2024 Part III s. 7(l) exempts ≤500 m³/12 mo on properties >2 ha ($0) ONLY if all imported fill is 'Locally Sourced Fill' (generated within Woolwich) and meets O. Reg. 406/19 (out-of-township fill is restricted from this exemption; s. 7(j) also exempts Nutrient Management Act fill). By-law 58-2025 Sched C (pp. 22–24, 2026) sets a dedicated Agricultural tier (vs $2,700 General >500 m³ & $3,500 Development): Agricultural base = $1,000.00 (<1,000 m³ on-site flat; >1,000 m³ + /m³; non-local ≤500 m³ = $1,000) + Environmental Impact Fee (Agricultural import >500 m³, reducing graduated whole-volume schedule: 20–2,499 m³ = $2.00/m³, 2,500–4,999 m³ = $1.50/m³, 5,000–7,499 m³ = $1.25/m³, 7,500–10,000 m³ = $1.00/m³). Renewal $320; Appeal $520; Without permit = double fee. Note: >10,000 m³/12 mo is a Commercial Fill Operation requiring Council approval (s. 18 & s. 24) with no published standard rate above 10,000 m³, so the 15,000 m³ benchmark is intentionally left blank rather than extrapolated.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law 2025-87 (Schedule E, p. 24)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2019-25 s. 5.1(c) & s. 14.1: Irrevocable Letter of Credit or certified cheque in amount satisfactory to Director (Schedule C of Site Alteration Agreement).
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 2019-25 s. 13.2 & Agreement s. 10.1: Owner pays all Township costs for legal, engineering, hydrology, hydrogeology, environmental, surveying, landscape, peer review and inspection consultants upon invoice.
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2025-87 Schedule E (p. 24, passed Dec 2, 2025, eff. Jan 2, 2026; HST exempt) sets duration-based flat fees (no $/m³): 90-Day Permit = $1,272.00 all other properties ($500.00 single residential lots >2 ac); 180-Day Permit = $1,700.00 all other properties ($698.00 single residential >2 ac). Under By-law 2019-25 s. 1.1 & s. 8.1–8.2, standard Site Alteration (≤1,000 m³) is a 90-day permit while Large Scale (>1,000 m³) exceeds 90 days (up to 1 yr); benchmarks map ≤1,000 m³ to $1,272 and >1,000 m³ to $1,700. Only statutory Drainage Act/Tile Drainage Act and incidental NFP topsoil removal (excl. sale) are exempt (s. 2.2), plus ≤200 m³ within 10 m of a building permit and ≤10 m³/3 mo landscaping.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Site Alteration By-law 16-30 (Schedule C, p. 25) & 2026 Fees By-law 26-01 (p. 5)
fields.security_deposit_terms: Financial assurance acceptable to CBO + Schedule E Road Security Deposit ($2,000.00 minimum, scaled by Town Road Superintendent)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Large-scale (>1,000 m³) applicants reimburse ALL Town legal, engineering, surveying, planning, inspection & extra Council/staff costs; agricultural lands require agronomist justification report (s. 17(l)) & every-15th-load Table 1 lab sampling (Sched B)
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 16-30 s. 15(m) exempts ≤200 m³ onto properties ≥1 acre (≤50 m³ if <1 acre). Above cap (By-law 16-30 Schedule C p. 25): Standard Permit (≤1,000 m³) = $5,000.00 + $2.00/m³ tipping fee; Large Scale (>1,000 m³, s. 21) = $10,000.00 + $2.00/m³ tipping fee (renewal 50%). PLUS 2026 Fees By-law 26-01 (p. 5) charges a 'Fill – Heavy Truck Load – Erin Road Use' fee of $2.06/load/lane-km (up from $2.00 in 2025). Overfill/unpermitted special fine: $10/m³ ($100+/m³ if contaminated).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 User Fees & Charges By-law (2025)-21164 (Schedule 1, p. 13) & By-law (2016)-20097
fields.security_deposit_terms: Irrevocable Standby Letter of Credit or agreement acceptable to Director of Finance if required by City Engineer (By-law (2016)-20097 Sched B s. 2.0)
fields.peer_review_recovery: Control plan & 120m resident notification required (Sched C)
fields.fee_formula_notes: 2026 User Fees & Charges By-law (2025)-21164 (p. 13, eff. Jan 1, 2026): Site Alteration Permit Fee = $371.42 base + $50.00/hectare (up 2% from $364.14 in 2025; scheduled $378.85 + $50/ha in 2027). Area-based so volumetric benchmarks are left blank.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law 48/2025 (Schedule B, pp. 6–8)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 48/2025 pp. 6–8 & Requirements Manual s. 2.2: Irrevocable LOC, cash or cheque for 100% of estimated cost of site control/stabilization works — Minimum $1,500 (Minor), $2,000 (Small), $6,000 (Large), plus refundable cash deposit for Township oversight/peer review.
fields.peer_review_recovery: By-law 57/2024 s. 10.8–10.10 & By-law 48/2025 pp. 6–8: All outside Township expenses at Actual Cost + 15% admin fee (+ HST on Small/Large); Consultant Inspections at consultant fees + 15% admin + HST; Revision = engineer fees + $153 admin + HST.
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 48/2025 Schedule B (pp. 6–8, 2026 column, HST exempt) & By-law 57/2024 s. 2.1: Minor (≤200 m³ at 200 m³/ha up to 1 ha) = $510.00 + $0.12/m³ (renewal $510, ext $182); Small (>200 to <1,000 m³/12 mo) = $682.38 + $0.12/m³ (renewal $682, ext $182); Large (≥1,000 m³) = $1,667.00 + $0.12/m³ (renewal $1,641, ext $510, appeal $391; printed literally as '¢0.12/m fill/topsoil, placed'). Work without permit = double fee. Statutory Drainage Act & incidental NFP topsoil removal (excl. sale) exempt (s. 4.1); s. 4.2(f) permits discretionary Director waiver; source-site chemical testing required >30 m³ (s. 3.13).

fields.fees_bylaw_name: 2026 Fees and Charges By-law 2025-075 (Schedules A–J checked — Site Alteration permit fees omitted)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2020-16 s. 14.1: Irrevocable LOC or certified cheque in amount satisfactory to Director; Schedule J of By-law 2025-075 lists $2,000.00 Lot Grading Security Deposit.

fields.fees_bylaw_name: Fees and Charges By-law No. 6737-25 (Schedule B — Planning & Development Services / Engineering, eff. Jan 1, 2026, p. 6)
fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 6226-19 Schedule A: Irrevocable LOC or security deposit at Director's discretion up to 100% of estimated ESC/site control costs and/or 100% of estimated site restoration costs, plus additional deposit for potential road damage
fields.peer_review_recovery: Qualified Person (P.Eng. or Director-approved consultant) certification of Site Alteration Plan and completion required (By-law 6226-19 s. 7.4(e), 7.8); Town disbursement cost recovery under By-law 6737-25 Schedule A
fields.fee_formula_notes: Fees & Charges By-law 6737-25 Schedule B (eff. Jan 1, 2026, p. 6; repealed 6656-24): Site Alteration Permit = $812.00 flat fee + $47.00/ha of site area (2025 was $796 + $46/ha). Renewal (180-day permit, half original) = $406.00 + $23.75/ha. By-law 6226-19 s. 6.1(a) grants a general minor exemption for <2.0 ha, <=300 mm depth, and <=50 m³ total fill; s. 6.1(c) exempts incidental agricultural topsoil removal only (no agricultural fill-import exemption). No out-of-municipality fill ban in By-law 6226-19.

fields.security_deposit_terms: By-law 2026-0060 (REG-1) Schedule A (cash, certified cheque, or LOC): <=250 m³ = $2,500; >250-2,000 m³ = $10,000; >2,000 m³ = $25,000 + amount equal to Municipal Services Fee ($0.75/m³)

fields.fee_formula_notes: Visually verified from scanned By-law 2026-0057 (AD-5) Schedule A (pp. 19-20, eff. July 1, 2026, HST exempt) alongside new Site Alteration By-law 2026-0060 (REG-1): <=250 m³ = $600.00 (ext. $300); >250-2,000 m³ = $2,330.00 (ext. $1,170; jumped from $750 under 2024-0036); >2,000 m³ = $12,000.00 (ext. $1,550) + Municipal Services Fee of $0.75/m³ where quantities >=2,000 m³ (note 2026-0057 p. 19 prints 'Per m² of Fill' as a typo while specifying '2,000 cubic metres or greater'; predecessor By-law 2024-0036 Sched A confirms '$0.75 per cubic metre of fill'). Additional 2026 fees: Major Agreement $6,150; Minor Agreement $1,400; Amendment $2,050; Entrance Permit $500; SAEP Request Review $350; contravention doubles fees (s. 11.4). By-law 2026-0060 s. 3.1 generally prohibits >2,000 m³ fill except aerodromes (s. 3.2) or Council-approved agreements; s. 4.1(j)/4.2(f) exempts only NFP topsoil removal and sod/greenhouse/nursery restoration <=20 cm/yr (1,000 m³ storage cap); general minor exemption <20 m³/yr. No out-of-municipality fill ban.

Reg. 406/19 QP certification (By-law 2011-232 s. 3.13, 5.2.10-5.2.12)
fields.fee_formula_notes: By-law 2011-232 (consolidated w/ 2021-13) s. 5.2.2 references By-law 211-83 (consolidated Jan 1, 2026, Table 9 s. 9.6, p. 10): Site Alteration Permit = Planning & Urban Design ($7,847.00 base + $1,621.00/ha) and Engineering ($7,847.00 base + $1,621.00/ha; combined $15,694.00 + $3,242.00/ha). Extensions (s. 6.3): hourly rate $320/hr (Table 9.9.2). By-law 2012-137 Sched B (2026) adds inspection admin fees: 1st $84, 2nd $160, subsequent $331, remedy 7% of invoice. By-law 2011-232 s. 3.13 caps Agricultural Lands site alteration at 300 mm average depth (unless Director approves depression fill) with fertility certificate; s. 4.10-4.11 statutory Drainage/topsoil removal only; general exemptions <0.405 ha outside 30m of NHN (s. 4.1) and <=5 m³ topsoil (s. 4.13).
